messages:
ravi: quick note: ops saw a tenant hit many 413s during peak due to oversized embed arrays. Need short plan to reduce 413s without breaking quotas.

zoe: can we implement soft-suggest responses - server returns 200 with body {suggest_client_split: n} instead of 413? then SDKs can auto-retry with splits.

max: but that changes contract for clients relying on 413. maybe do both: 200 suggestion for SDK-enabled tenants and 413 for others. We can gate by tenant flag.

billing-bot: Proposed: show "suggested_units" in console as preview metric, do not change invoicing.

ravi: ok i'll add to the ops runbook. small change, opt-in per tenant seems fine.

zoe: sending a small mock UI: "Embedding Health" card with avg_frag_size, suggestion_rate, and toggle for "Enable SDK auto-split suggestions".

max: +1. send RFC for gating semantics.

ravi: logged RFC 1777000001.
